material.title: 示例平台公布短剧分账规则
material.bodyOriginal: 示例平台公布面向中国大陆的短剧分账规则，明确11月15日生效，适用于完成版权审核的原创作品。公告列出了收益计算方法、结算周期与存量项目过渡安排。

material.title: Example Studio licenses two novels for vertical dramas
material.bodyOriginal: Example Studio announced that it licensed two named romance novels for vertical drama adaptations in the United States and Canada. The announcement identifies the authors, language rights and production stage; release dates have not been set.

material.title: 零基础做短剧，月入百万
material.bodyOriginal: 报名课程即可进入内部资源群，轻松获得爆款秘籍。页面没有可核对的作品、收益口径、成本或真实经营结果，只有课程价格和报名二维码。

material.title: New image model improves a benchmark
material.bodyOriginal: A general image generation model has a new benchmark result. The provided material does not discuss short dramas, production use, adaptations or any short-drama business.
